audit.whatIsWrong: early and wants.you[1] tell you to hold Aegis Assault to block the grenade. Aegis Assault blocks damage, not the stun — and the stun is what ends the channel.
audit.why: Riot's CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade text: it deals damage 'as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units', on 11 seconds at 970 range. The kit flags Aegis Assault as a channel any CC cancels. So channelling into the grenade spends 22 seconds and still eats the stun. The saving detail is in the same sentence: only a DIRECT hit stuns — clipped by the edge you are merely slowed, so sidestepping the centre is the real answer.
audit.corrected: Only a direct grenade hit stuns; the outer ring just slows. Sidestep the centre rather than channelling into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ability is called 'CH-2 Grenade' in winCon, the cooldown block, focus.text and the interactions row, and UPGRADE!!! is never named at all.
audit.why: Riot's names are CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade and UPGRADE!!!. The ultimate matters here because it does not do damage of its own — it 'causes his next spell to have increased effects', so a 100s UPGRADE!!! held with the grenade up is a much bigger stun waiting for your engage. Nothing on the page told you that his ultimate is a threat multiplier on the exact ability that cancels your channel.
audit.corrected: Full grenade name used; UPGRADE!!! named as a 100s empowerment that upgrades the grenade stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Coverage flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and no Heimerdinger ability is named in the content layer.
audit.why: Grenade 11s at 970, Hextech Micro-Rockets 11s at 1325, turrets on a 1s charge cooldown, UPGRADE!!! 100s. The number that explains the lane is 1325 against Comet Spear's 575 — he outranges your poke by more than double, so there is no poke war to win, only an engage window.
audit.corrected: Ranges and cooldowns added to spikes, wants, early, mid and the cooldown block.

audit.why: 48.46% over 324 games — a losing lane on the smallest sample in this slice. The chart giving Heimerdinger level 1 and level 6 while Pantheon holds 3-5 and the item stages is generous to Pantheon, but the prose is honest that the lane belongs to the turret nest and the win comes from leaving it.

edits.before: Level 1 is the only window I truly own — point-and-click W to stun and Q to poke before his first turret matters, so I want to fight the literal first chance I get. But the second he has two turrets in the wave it flips: my melee Q can't reach him through the turret zone, and stepping in for W means eating turret beams plus a W rocket. Hold Aegis Assault (E) to block his E grenade — if that stun lands while I'm dashing, I'm dead in the open.
edits.after: Level 1 is the only window I truly own — Shield Vault's leap-stun and a Q poke before his first turret matters, so I fight at the first chance. Once two turrets sit in the wave it flips: Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 to my 575, so there is no poke war here. And do NOT channel Aegis Assault into the grenade: only a direct hit stuns, the edge merely slows, so sidestep the centre instead of blocking it.

edits.before: By 3-5 the lane belongs to Heimer. His turrets wall me off the minions and out-zone my W all-in, and every time I walk up I take turret DPS plus rocket poke I can't heal — I have no sustain. Don't keep feeding the nest. At 6, Grand Starfall isn't a lane-kill button here; it's my ticket out — leap to mid or bot, get a kill, and come back with the lead I can't earn standing in his turrets.
edits.after: By 3-5 the lane belongs to Heimerdinger. Turrets wall me off the minions, Hextech Affinity speeds him up inside his own nest, and I have no sustain for the chip. At 6 he gains UPGRADE!!! on 100s, which does no damage itself — it empowers his next spell, so assume the grenade waiting for my engage is the upgraded one. Grand Starfall is my ticket out: leap to mid or bot and earn the lead elsewhere.

notes: Same failure pattern as several other entries in this champion: the page prescribed Aegis Assault as the answer to a hard-CC ability. Riot's grenade text stuns anyone 'directly hit', and the kit flags Pantheon's E as a channel any CC cancels, so holding the block spends 22 seconds and still eats the stun. The usable half of the same sentence — the outer ring only slows — was never on the page, and sidestepping the centre is free. _missing-interactions.json also lists UPGRADE!!! as a channel-canceller; that is indirect (the ultimate itself only empowers his next spell) so I wrote it as an empowered grenade rather than as CC in its own right. Micro-Rockets at 1325 against Comet Spear's 575 is the number that explains why there is no poke war to win.
